name: Life In The Static
author: Addicting Games
description: Life in the static is a puzzle. It is a question waiting to be answered. It is a solution waiting to be discovered and a challenge begging to be dominated. Do you have the ingenuity, the stamina, and the resolve of a thousand exploding suns all waiting to be unchained and set free from the static? The static is not your friend and it will challenge your ability to solve its puzzling nature. The challenges will get harder and more complicated as time goes on. You will be forced to overcome floating platforms, sliding bridges, disappearing blocks, and all other kinds of obstacles. The static is a harsh mistress, one that takes all as prisoners. As you attempt to escape you may find yourself asking What is life? What is static? And what would be a life in the static? The static is everywhere, the static is everything. The static is your entire existence and you'll be stuck in it forever if you want. But maybe you can escape. Maybe you can gather your will and ttest it against the growing clouds of a dead grey void as it consumes everything around it, including you. Life in the static is an exciting platform puzzle adventure where players are forced to live out the existential nightmare of living within the static between worlds if they can't find the gumption to escape. Run, jump and even double-jump to escape your fate. The exit is always on the other side of the screen, behind a wall of obstacles.
